newsitem.title: USA: MBIA qualifies seven bond issues for insurance.
newsitem.headline: MBIA qualifies seven bond issues for insurance.

text.p: MBIA Insurance Corp. said it qualified for bond insurance following seven municipal bond issues slated for competitive sale on Monday.
--College CSD, Iowa, $4.9 million of general obligation bonds.
--Lawrence Township Metro, Ind., $7.5 million GO bonds.
--St. Clair Shores, Mich., $2.7 million water and sewer revenue bonds.
--Nottingham MUD, Texas, $2.3 million of unlimited tax bonds.
--Spring Branch ISD, Texas, $3.035 million public finance finance bonds.
--Milton SD, Wis., $4.1 million of GO refunding bonds. --U.S. Municipal Desk, 212-859-1650
